product_one_liner.value: Aviso AI is an agentic revenue platform for sales and go-to-market teams that unifies forecasting, pipeline intelligence, coaching, and automated revenue workflows.

pricing_page.notes: The public pricing page lists product capabilities and requests a tailored proposal; it does not publish dollar prices.

employee_band.notes: Reported workforce count is 391; headcount is not an audited figure.

eng_blog.notes: Under the requested engineer-authored standard: substantial architecture posts are credited to a research/content author. One qualifying implementation-oriented post by a lead data scientist was identified; a second engineer-authored product-build post was not established.

public_docs.notes: Public knowledge-base articles cover the dashboard, Microsoft Dynamics integration, onboarding, and sales-rep performance.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The open-positions list has no qualifying AI, ML, or data-science title; Data Engineer does not count under the requested definition.

model_provider.notes: Aviso explicitly says it blends these open-weight models with proprietary NLP and deep-learning technologies; general mentions of other providers were not treated as proof of use.

compliance_certs.notes: These are the public compliance claims named on the page; GDPR is described as an internal assessment and compliance review, not an independent certification.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest recorded financing is January 2022, before the 2025-05-09 to 2026-11-09 window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The official careers site lists an Account Executive opening for remote USA and Canada.

launched_6mo.notes: On 2026-06-16, Aviso introduced its AI CSM for autonomous digital customer-success account management, within the 2026-05-09 to 2026-11-09 window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: On 2026-02-04, Aviso announced Al Arun as its new EVP of Professional Services, Customer Success, and Adoption.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The public documentation includes an Integrating Microsoft Dynamics article. This establishes integration support, not necessarily Aviso’s internal CRM.
